card.title: Night of the Eclipse
card.summary: Seven minutes into the eclipse, the observatory's energy well starts draining moonlight. The Eclipse Mage learns it's draining memory — and the bottom of the well holds everything the city deleted.

hero-luna-01.title: Segment 1 · Eclipse
hero-luna-01.summary: Every light in the city drops a notch, and a well that shouldn't exist lights up on the observatory roof.

l1-intro.speaker: Narration
l1-intro.text: Seven minutes into the eclipse, the observatory's energy well lit up. Every light in the city dimmed at the same moment.

l1-hero.speaker: Eclipse Mage
l1-hero.text: They're stealing the moon. Or rather, stealing everything the moonlight falls on.

l1-choice.prompt: The console offers two options. Neither lists the consequences.

l1-shut.speaker: Eclipse Mage
l1-shut.text: Shut it down and nobody takes another memory tonight. The price is that the whole district goes dark with it.

l1-take.speaker: Voice from the Well
l1-take.text: "Clever. Take it, and you'll see everything they deleted from everyone." — The voice comes from the well. It also comes from her own throat.

l1-battle.title: The Well
l1-battle.brief: The guards aren't human. The last one is her.

waves.label: Wave 1
waves.event: The eclipse deepens; the edges of your vision go black

skills.name: Suppression Sweep
skills.description: A circular sweep that slows whatever it hits

waves.label: Wave 2
waves.event: Another her is projected from the wellhead, moving in perfect sync

l1-after.speaker: Narration
l1-after.text: When the moonshade scattered, only a thin film of light was left in the well. The city lit back up as if nothing had happened.

l1-reward.title: The Well, Extinguished
l1-reward.description: The observatory filed a report: equipment failure, no injuries. The report was not deleted.

l1-end.title: End of Segment 1
l1-end.text: She looked up at the moon one last time. Tonight it owed nobody anything.

hero-luna-02.title: Segment 2 · The Borrowed Night
hero-luna-02.summary: The memories the well drained have piled into a night with no exit, inside the city's dreams.

l2-intro.speaker: Narration
l2-intro.text: On the third night after the well went dark, the Eclipse Mage had a dream that was far too lucid. In it, the whole city repeated the same night.

l2-hero.speaker: Eclipse Mage
l2-hero.text: This isn't a dream. It's stolen memory with nowhere to go back to.

l2-choice.prompt: A lamp burns in the middle of the dream, and someone waits beside it.
options: Get the trapped people out first

l2-follow.speaker: Eclipse Mage
l2-follow.text: Someone sits under the lamp. When she looks up, her face is blurred — her memory isn't whole.

l2-battle.title: Memory Wardens
l2-battle.brief: The memory layer doesn't welcome the living. Its guards are stitched from other people's recollections.

waves.label: Wave 1
waves.event: Every melody repeats the same bar from seventeen years ago

skills.name: String Lock
skills.description: Strings pin your feet and keep bleeding you

waves.label: Wave 2
waves.event: The dream starts repeating; your steps arrive late

skills.name: Sound Suppression
skills.description: Sustained sound waves that slow and damage

l2-after.speaker: Narration
l2-after.text: When the guards scattered, the blurred face finally cleared. She was the observatory's registrar, who should have clocked out seventeen years ago.

l2-reward.title: One Lamp
l2-reward.description: The dream's exit opened. But the lamp is still lit, which means someone hasn't left.

l2-end.title: End of Segment 2
l2-end.text: The Eclipse Mage left last. She memorised where the lamp stands.

hero-luna-03.title: Segment 3 · Moonfall
hero-luna-03.summary: The bottom of the well holds the whole city's memory. Give it back, or burn it?

l3-intro.speaker: Narration
l3-intro.text: The observatory was sealed for three days. On the fourth, the Eclipse Mage went down to the well alone.

l3-hero.speaker: Eclipse Mage
l3-hero.text: Everything the city deleted is piled down here. Names, faces, things nobody said out loud.

l3-choice.prompt: The console at the bottom shows one line: RELEASE / DESTROY.
options: Give the memory back to the city
Burn it and let everyone start over

l3-give.speaker: Eclipse Mage
l3-give.text: Give it back, and the city remembers what it did. Including the people who'd rather not.

l3-battle.title: Moonfall
l3-battle.brief: The last guard at the bottom is the shadow the moon left behind.

waves.label: Wave 1
waves.event: The first daylight falls in and the shadows stretch

skills.name: Well Sweep
skills.description: Circular sweep that slows on hit

waves.label: Wave 2
waves.event: The shadow stops imitating. It starts moving a step early

l3-after.speaker: Narration
l3-after.text: When the shadow scattered, the first daylight reached the bottom of the well. The Eclipse Mage pressed the key.

l3-reward.title: Moonfall
l3-reward.description: The next day, many people in the city remembered the same thing at once. The report called it mass delusion.

l3-end.title: End of Segment 3
l3-end.text: She walked out of the observatory. The moon had set. The sky was bright.
